day_local: ULwesine Weveki Yamashumi Amabini Anesibhozo Ngexesha Loqhelekileyo
greeting: Igama likaThixo uSomandla, uYise, uNyana, noMoya Oyingcwele libe nawe. Makube uxolo lukaKristu lube nani nonke enibuthene apha namhlanje ukuba siphefumle elizwini lakhe.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Abo bakulandelayo, Nkosi, baya kuba nokukhanya kobomi.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu ongasemva kwemini apho ilanga liqala ukuzika, kwaye imithunzi emide iqala ukuthabathela indawo ukukhanya kwemini. Kule ngokuhlwa, xa ujonge efestiteleni, ubona nje izinto ezijikelezileyo zithula, kwaye indlu ibonakala inzima kakhulu kunokuba yayinjalo kusasa. Ucinga ngaloo mboniso omnandi womntwana wakho, uBenjamin, xa wayehleli etafileni yakhe ebusuku, ejonge iincwadi zezibalo okanye ephendla iimephu zeenqwelo-moya, enomdla wokwazi yonke into eyenzekayo kweli hlabathi. Wayengumfana owayengonwabisi nje ngobuchule bakhe, kodwa ngenxa yokuba intliziyo yakhe yayizele kukuqonda okukhulu nothando olungazenzisiyo. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos usibeka phambi kwento enzulu kakhulu: 'Inqaku lokuqala lilelokuba, ukuba siyakhokelwa nguMoya, asiphantsi komthetho.' Uqhuba athi iziqhamo zoMoya luthando, uvuyo, uxolo, ukunyamezela, ububele, ukuba nobubele, ukuthembeka, nobulali. Apha, umpostile akathethi nje ngezinto zangaphandle; uthetha ngendlela intliziyo yethu eboshwa ngayo kukuzama ukulawula zonke iingozi, kukuzama ukuba yiyo yonke into kubantu abasithandayo ukuze kungabikho nto imbi eyenzekayo. Nisenze konke okusemandleni enu, Alan noThao. Nizanile ngothando olungenamiqathango, olunzulu, olungazigciniyo nto. Kodwa ihlabathi linamendu alo, kwaye zintlungu eziqhekeza imiphefumlo yethu ngendlela esingayiqondiyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje kaLuka, uYesu ukhankanya amazwi abuhlungu kakhulu kubafundi bomthetho nabaFarisi. Uthi: 'Nimisa imithwalo kubantu ekunzima ukuyithwala, kwaye nina aniyichukumisi nangenxa yomnwe wenu.' Lo mfanekiso womthwalo onzima usikhumbuza ubunzima bokuba ngumntu phantsi kweli hlabathi. Ubomi buhlala busibeka imithwalo enzima kakhulu, ngakumbi xa umntu othandekayo ehamba. Kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele ekhaya kuThixo, kukho imizuzu apho umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uziva unzima kakhulu. Ucinga ngaloo mboniso kaBen esesemncinci, xa wayecinga ngokunika yonke imali yasebhange encinci yakhe ukuba incede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayisengcamango yentliziyo yakhe emsulwa, kodwa loo nqaku lokuba umntwana omncane kangaka abe nomnqweno wokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala kuyasityhilela ukuba intliziyo kaBen yayingenabuzoweni, yayizaliswe luthando olunyulu lukaThixo.

Masimi apha ixesha elincinci… Masicinge ngendlela ubomi bukaBen obabuzaliswe ngayo kukukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhleka, owayejonga uyise ngamehlo okumncoma, owayeyazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukuba ngumntu owabelana ngovuyo nabanye. Kwakunye nomnqweno wakhe wokwakha i-‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, eyayiziindiza zamaphupha akhe, uBen wayesixelela ukuba umphefumlo womntwana awuyeki ukubhabha. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha nawe Alan, nawe Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ngendlela enyanisekileyo. Ndiyazi ukuba umthwalo wosizi uyamfulathela umntu ebusuku. Kukho imibuzo eza ithi, 'Kutheni?' Kukho amaxesha apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphelela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi kwabo babesenza imithetho kodwa bengekho eluthandweni, 'Nibe nobulungisa nothando lukaThixo.' Ubulungisa bukaThixo asisisiqwenga somthetho esixinzelelayo; lububele obukukhululayo. UBen akalahlekanga; usebukhoneni obukhulu boMthombo wothando. Uthi xa ucinga ngaye, ucinga ngaloo ntwana enemfesane, umfana owayephethe ukukhanya okukhulu kangaka. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam Yesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliCewele leAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, ndizidibanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo; ungalokothi uvumele ukuba ndahlulwe nawe. Amen.
closing: UThixo uSomandla akusikelele kwaye akugcine, akuvule la mehlo ukuba ubone ukukhanya kwakhe kuyo yonke imihla yobomi bakho. Amen.
standing_petitions: Siy thầyela umfana uBenjamin nabo bonke abasele bedlulile, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu nongunaphakade.
Siy thầyela bonke abasiziweyo nabo balila, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba eliqinisekileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text:
Bazalwana:
Ukuba nikhokelwa nguMoya, aniphantsi komthetho.
Kaloku imisebenzi yenyama iyabonakala, eyileyo:
ukuba ngamanxila, ukungcola, ukuzibandakanya kwizinto ezimbi, unqulo lwezithombe,
ubuvakalisi, intiyo, ukulwa, umona,
ukucaphuka, ubugovu,
ukwahlukana, amaqela, umona,
ukuphuza kakhulu, imibhiyozo emibi, enjenjalo.
Ndiyanixwayisa, njengoko ndanixwayisa ngaphambili,
ukuba abo benza ezi zinto abayi kuyidla ilifa uBukumkani bukaThixo.
Ngokwahlukileyo koko, iziqhamo zoMoya luthando, uvuyo, uxolo,
ukunyamezela, ububele, ukuba nobubele,
ukuthembeka, ubulali, ukuzibamba.
Asikho isohlwayo esichasene nezi zinto.
Kaloku abo bangabakaKristu Yesu bayibethelele inyama yabo
neminqweno yayo.
Ukuba siphila ngoMoya, masilandele uMoya.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text:
R. Abo bakulandelayo, Nkosi, baya kuba nokukhanya kobomi.
Ubusisekile umntu ongahambiyo
ngeluleko labangendawo,
ongemi endleleni yezoni,
ongahlali kwindibano yabaswela intlonipho,
Onyenyela emthethweni kaNELIKA
olungiselela umthetho wakhe imini nobusuku.
R. Abo bakulandelayo, Nkosi, baya kuba nokukhanya kobomi.
Unjengomthi
otyalwe kufutshane namanzi abhabhabhayo,
Ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha lawo,
aqabane lawo angaze abune.
Konke akwenzayo kuyaphumelela.
R. Abo bakulandelayo, Nkosi, baya kuba nokukhanya kobomi.
Akunjalo kwabangendawo, akunjalo;
banjengomoya oqhubela kude uthuli.
Kuba uNELIKA uyalinda indlela yabalungisa,
kanti indlela yabangendawo iyatshabalala.
R. Abo bakulandelayo, Nkosi, baya kuba nokukhanya kobomi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text:
Nkosi yathi:
“Yeha nina baFarisi!
Nihlawula amashumi eziqholo zezityalo zonke zentsimi,
kanti anikhathali ngobulungisa nothando lukaThixo.
Kwakuqale kwafuneka nenze ezi zinto, ningashiyanga nezinye.
Yeha nina baFarisi!
Nithanda izihlalo eziphezulu ezindlwini zesikhungo
nemibuliso ezintengweni.
Yeha nina!
Ninje ngamangcwaba angabonwayo abantu abahamba ngawo bengazi.”
Kaza kwabakho omnye wabachazi bomthetho owaphendula wathi:
“Mfundisi, ngala mazwi usinyembela nathi.”
Yathi yona:
“Yeha nani bachazi bomthetho!
Nibhokoxa abantu ngemithwalo enzima ukuyithwala,
kanti nina aniyichukumisi nangenxa yomnwe wenu.”

day: Wednesday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
